answer: Because the garden index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the velvet audit republishes the full set. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 204 answers need 204 separate inference runs with separate seeds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
